doc.title: Benny Powell interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, July 27, 1995 [interview 1 of 2]

title: Humor in jazz and the Basie band
summary: Powell says jazz musicians have great humor and the Basie band was one big laugh for twelve years.

story.theme_name: Playing with Count Basie: joining, leading, leaving
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

blocks.x: You know you mentioned another element along with the sense of spirituality that I think is a part of jazz, you mentioned humor.

Oh, yeah, it’s a vital part. I think it’s a vital part to life for me. And it seems like, well I don’t know, maybe birds of a feather are drawn together. It seems like most jazz musicians do have terrific senses of humor. I know in Basie’s band it was one big laugh for 12 years. You know, everybody was a comedian, and some really unique humor, because it was unique personalities you know. Basie’s band was very interesting.
